26/S0.subgoal: Explain the basic flow of the perception process from sensing stimuli to neural impulses.

26/S1.subgoal: Describe the physical characteristics and neuron count of the cerebral cortex.

26/S2.subgoal: Describe the structure of a neuron and the basic mechanics of neural impulse transmission.

26/S3.subgoal: Explain how neural connections can be modeled as a directed graph with nodes and edges.

26/S4.subgoal: Explain the role of synapses and the complexity of the brain's neural network.

26/S5.subgoal: Describe how hierarchical processing allows the brain to detect increasingly complex patterns.

26/S6.subgoal: Explain how the brain combines real-time sensory input with long-term experience to interpret stimuli.

26/S7.subgoal: Describe proprioception as a 'sixth sense' for sensing body position and muscle effort.

26/S8.subgoal: Describe how sensory mismatches in immersive systems lead to cyber sickness and the need for balanced design.

26/S9.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
